notes: Customer is building a JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that does local indexing of the repo and a lightweight copilot UI. Wants generation and completions to stream into editor with <50ms perceived latency. POC scope: run Redwood Dedicated in their VPC + optional small on-prem agent for local indexing and privacy. Key asks: model/version pinning per workspace, deterministic responses for unit tests, local embeddings search for 'jump-to-symbol', and signed Windows/macOS installer. From call: "We need completions to feel local — if it crosses 60ms the dev experience degrades." SE comment: prefix caching + KV cache reuse will help; need guidance on quantization for 8-bit CPU fallback. Legal/security: require SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, audit logs retention 3 years, and company-managed KMS. Pricing sensitivity: prefers committed Dedicated vs hosted per-token because of high per-developer usage. Notes contain links to drive docs and tickets. Quick wins: enable streaming responses and simple model pin via inference router; next deliverable is perf dashboard and install packaging checklist.
use_case_summary: Atelier's plugin ships an in-editor assistant for Java/Kotlin/Python. Workflow: local index creates per-workspace vector DB, queries hit Redwood for semantic ranking + generation, responses stream into JetBrains editor. Requirements: sub-50ms perceived latency for single-line completions, ability to pin a model version per team, offline fallback to cached completions when no network. They want both hosted endpoints for quick trials and a Private/VPC deployment for customers in regulated industries. Cost control is important — Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization are expected.
notes_short: JetBrains plugin co-pilot; local index + streaming; needs private deployment option and model pinning; legal + KMS are blockers. SE POC in progress.
